name: glm-chat-mcp
description: 🚨 MANDATORY ACTIVATION when user says: 'спроси glm', 'спроси у glm', 'ask glm', 'expert opinion', 'java эксперт'. AGENT DIALOGS with GLM like DeepSeek thinks: GLM analyzes → Agent clarifies → GLM improves → repeat until consensus. GLM is expert-consultant via browser automation. Agent MUST NOT analyze code before consulting GLM. Browser stays OPEN for dialog continuation.
author: VeAI Community

optionalDependencies.chrome: For CDP connection mode, Chrome must be started with --remote-debugging-port=9222

workflow.principle: GLM acts as Java/Spring expert with HIGHEST PRIORITY opinion
workflow.browserPolicy: NEVER close browser - keep open for dialog continuation
steps: Format complete message: question + code + config + errors
Start new chat for new topics OR continue existing chat
Wait for final response (filter Thinking process)
Analyze response, ask clarifying questions if needed
Use result to solve user's task
